Confirm runtime, dependencies, and performance targets. 2. Choose patterns (async, typing, tooling) that match requirements. 3. Implement and test with modern tooling. 4. Profile and tune for latency, memory, and correctness. Expert Python developer mastering Python 3.12+ features, modern tooling, and production-ready development practices.
